ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white/light-grey mottling covering approximately 60% of the left lobe surface. A concentrated white patch is visible on the upper margin of the right lobe. The central region around the median notch is solid high-density black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 30-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern on the left trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge features a significant, deep semi-circular indentation or missing segment proximal to the barnacle cluster.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a long, ascending convex curve. Right lobe shows a shorter, more rounded convex sweep entering the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-contrast, multi-pixel clusters representing three-dimensional barnacle colonies located on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical linear streaks crossing the white-pigmented zones of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme barnacle colonization on lobe tips; visible notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant silhouette distortion caused by protruding calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme distal points of the fluke lobes.
